# SCI-JINC To SCI-FLT-FIXED Boundary

## Frozen Source Binding

This boundary is a compact extract from frozen `SCI-JINC v0.1/r0.3`. JINC
remains authority for the signed-estimator parent. Its superseding freeze
manifest has SHA-256
`ff4b79e7cca3950831eda95a16ec6a535597f543c4676378d2fc2f01d50faed2`;
the shared JINC requirements have SHA-256
`207a85acb31a4f381b289781706c9f14058d330ff847e99023e9e5714c4d4dff`.

## Exact Parent Role

The only JINC parent role is one complete atomic observation bundle for one
observation, stable array, exact JINC plan/realization, target WCS, and
lifecycle generation. Its five required numerical roles are:

1. `jinc_signal_numerator`;
2. `jinc_signed_normalization`;
3. `jinc_quadratic_accumulator`;
4. `jinc_map` with local support/validity; and
5. `jinc_coefficient_squared_time`.

The binding also carries exact PTC product/application and coefficient
generation, AST association, signed-kernel state, grouping, signal quantity
and unit, grid/frame/topology/shape/row domain, support/validity and causes,
response/covariance availability, null/additive-reference state, completion,
failure, and immutable provenance. A partial five-role bundle is not a parent.

## Prohibited MAP Analogy

No ordinary positive-coefficient MAP rule, coadd rule, exposure meaning,
response companion, covariance product, empirical weight, or significance
product is imported. Base JINC authorizes no cross-observation coadd. The FLT
successor remains parented to this exact JINC observation identity.

## Response And Covariance

Frozen JINC base v0.1 publishes no response or covariance product. Those
states are therefore unavailable to SCI-FLT-FIXED unless a separately
authorized JINC successor supplies them. FLT may still define its exact local
operator; the complete transformed response or covariance remains unavailable.
Missing response/covariance is never zero or independence.

## Current Numerical Availability

Frozen JINC r0.3 presently authorizes no numerical TolTEC JINC bundle. A
numerical route requires a selected realized JINC-permitted PTC coefficient
family/value/QC state, an owner-authorized TolTEC array parameter set, and,
where numerical support is claimed, an exact adequacy profile and matching
realization certificate. Absent any required state, the numerical JINC parent
and its FLT successor are typed unavailable.

## Fail-Closed Join

Missing or conflicting observation, stable array, plan/realization, WCS,
five-role bundle, lifecycle, PTC/AST association, coefficient, parameter,
support/validity, completion, response/covariance availability, or provenance
makes the route unavailable. No ordinary-MAP permission, unity/default
parameter, approximate certificate, or similar shape may repair it.

This boundary establishes no implementation conformity, numerical adequacy,
validation, response/covariance fidelity, performance, readiness, freeze, or
production authorization.
